verdict.rationale: Stripe Checkout documents a fully-featured payment page that customers reach by redirect to a Stripe-hosted page, built with prebuilt UIs through the Checkout Sessions API. It supports 125+ local payment methods, and Payment Links offer a no-code hosted alternative. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the hosted page is conversion-optimized, independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted redirect flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI

citations.quote: Customers enter their payment details in a fully-featured payment page, either embedded on your site or via a redirect to a Stripe-hosted page.
Create a payments page with prebuilt UIs using the Checkout Sessions API.
Accept one-time and subscription payments from more than 125 local payment methods.
Let your customers use a link to pay in their local language and currency with their preferred payment method.
